title: 第11章 力量升级第12章 再探妖精里昂的商店
slug: 人在美利坚我的叔叔堂吉诃德
content_zh:
等到他来到德洛丽丝买手店的时候，已经是上午9点钟了。
神秘的德洛丽丝夫人并不在店内，李维在另一个女性导购员的指引之下换上了那套昂贵的迪奥西装，喷了一些不知名、但是昂贵到他不想关注价钱的香水之后，开始了今天上午的兼职工作。
德洛丽丝夫人似乎是一个很神秘的人，这间开在麦迪逊大道黄金位置的买手店似乎并不靠卖衣服赚钱，起码李维是这么想的。
因为他已经是第二天来兼职了，但是直到临近中午结束的时候，他也只是见到了工作后的第二个客人而已。
但是看到这位客人又像是买一瓶可口可乐一样买了一个价值4000美金的手袋之后，李维决定不要有那么高的好奇心，继续在这家店里面混日子，当好自己薪水小偷的角色。
20美金的时薪、2%的提成和小费，而且一天只需要工作3个小时、服务一个客人就能领到税后102美金的工资，还上哪儿找这么好的工作去。
万一他主动跟德洛丽丝夫人提起这件事，后者一算账发现“对哦，这活儿根本不挣钱”，直接把他踢了，那他就没地方说理去了。
换下衣服之后，李维十分自觉地没有把脚往那些看上去就很贵的餐厅里面迈步——他可是看见了路边的招牌，一份三明治或者沙拉碗就要他70美金以上。
先是坐地铁来到了时代广场中转，随后李维在街边的热狗餐车里面花了13美金买了一大份涂满了千岛酱和烧烤酱的大份热狗，就当解决了自己的午餐。
下午2点左右李维回到了地下室中，眼看堂吉诃德没有任何回来的迹象，他想了想，还是打算去一趟健身房，试试看能不能触发一些新的任务。
下午的健身房内，人要比上次来少了很多，只有大猫小猫两三个在零零散散的做着训练。
李维再次拒绝了前台白人壮汉的私教课推销，换好衣服之后先上了跑步机，打算测试一下自己的体质增强了多少。
前两天在地下室漏水的时候，他把0.1个属性点加在了体质上，现在还没有测试过1.0的体质所能代表的运动能力。
“800米......900米......1000米！”
5分半的配速跑完1000米之后，让李维感到惊喜的是他的目前的体能储备依旧充沛，不管是心率还是酸胀的感觉都比体质只有0.9的时候好上不少。
1.0的体质是20岁成年人的标准体质，而这让他在以同样的配速下跑了整整3公里之后，才喘着粗气从跑步机上走了下来。
“嘿，哥们儿，”一个声音传来，“你是不是要去富兰克林·k·莱恩高中上学？”
正在白嫖健身房免费矿泉水的李维有些警觉的扭过头一看，发现说话的人是一个年龄跟他差不多大的黑人。
“我叫迈克尔，”黑人礼貌的伸出手，颇有些兴高采烈，“我那天在学校里看见你了，我在富兰克林读12年级（相当于高三）。”
李维上下打量了迈克尔一眼，伸出手轻轻跟他握了握。

“你是跟你父亲一起来的吗？”迈克尔问道，“为什么会想来富兰克林读高中，我就没见过几个亚洲人去那边上学。”
“堂吉诃德是我的表叔，”李维耸了耸肩，“我是来美利坚投奔他的。”
“哦！是这样，”迈克尔似乎对于能交到一个亚洲同学而很兴奋，“你今天要练什么？我们一起练啊。”
李维看着5分钟之前还是陌生人的迈克尔如今一脸自来熟的样子，不免有些警惕。
他可是从堂吉诃德那里听了很多少年毒贩的故事。
简单来说就是美利坚的公立高中里面或多或少的都会有一些跟黑帮挂钩的学生，属于黑帮的编外成员，给学校里面的学生兜售毒品。
眼前的人从肤色和行为上都非常可疑。
他刚要拒绝的时候，就听到了系统的提示音：
【触发任务：骑士精神】
content_en:
By the time he arrived at Delores's buyer's store, it was already 9 o'clock in the morning.
The mysterious Mrs. Dolores was not in the store. Under the guidance of another female shopping guide, Levi put on the expensive Dior suit, sprayed some unknown but expensive perfume that he didn't want to pay attention to, and started his part-time job this morning.
Mrs. Dolores seems to be a very mysterious person. This boutique located in a prime location on Madison Avenue does not seem to make money from selling clothes, at least that's what Levi thinks.
Because he came to work part-time on the second day, but until the end of the day near noon, he only saw the second customer after work.
But after seeing this customer buying a $4,000 handbag as if he were buying a bottle of Coca-Cola, Levi decided not to be so curious and continue to hang out in the store, playing the role of his own salary thief.
An hourly wage of 20 US dollars, 2% commission and tips, and you only need to work 3 hours a day and serve one customer to receive a salary of 102 US dollars after tax. Where can you find such a good job?
If he takes the initiative to mention this matter to Mrs. Dolores, and the latter finds out, "Yes, this job is not profitable at all" and kicks him directly, then he will have no place to reason.
After changing his clothes, Levi very consciously did not step into those expensive-looking restaurants - he saw the sign on the roadside, and a sandwich or salad bowl cost him more than 70 US dollars.
First, he took the subway to transit in Times Square, and then Levi spent 13 US dollars on a large hot dog smeared with Thousand Island sauce and barbecue sauce from a hot dog cart on the street, which he treated as his lunch.
Levi returned to the basement around 2 o'clock in the afternoon. Seeing that Don Quixote showed no sign of coming back, he thought for a while and decided to go to the gym to see if he could trigger some new tasks.
In the afternoon, there were much fewer people in the gym than last time. There were only two or three big cats and kittens doing scattered training.
Levi once again refused the personal training offer offered by the strong white man at the front desk. After changing his clothes, he got on the treadmill, intending to test how much his physique had improved.
When there was a water leak in the basement two days ago, he added 0.1 attribute points to his physique. He has not yet tested the athletic ability that a 1.0 physique can represent.
"800 meters...900 meters...1000 meters!"
After running 1,000 meters at a pace of 5 and a half minutes, Levi was pleasantly surprised that his current physical reserves were still sufficient. Both his heart rate and soreness were much better than when his physical fitness was only 0.9.
A 1.0 physique is the standard physique for a 20-year-old adult, and this allowed him to run a full 3 kilometers at the same pace before he stepped off the treadmill panting.
"Hey, man," a voice called, "are you going to Franklin K. Lane High School?"
Levi, who was enjoying the free mineral water at the gym, turned his head warily and saw that the person speaking was a black man about his age.
"My name is Michael," the black man stretched out his hand politely, quite cheerfully, "I saw you in school that day. I am in grade 12 (equivalent to the third year of high school) in Franklin."
Levi looked Michael up and down, stretched out his hand and shook him gently.
"Did you come here with your father?" Michael asked, "Why do you want to come to Franklin to attend high school? I haven't seen many Asians go to school there."
"Don Quixote is my cousin," Levi shrugged, "I came to America to join him."
"Oh! That's right," Michael seemed very happy to be able to make an Asian classmate.Excitedly, "What are you going to practice today? Let's practice together."
Levi looked at Michael, who was a stranger 5 minutes ago, and now looked familiar, and couldn't help but be a little wary.
He had heard many stories about young drug dealers from Don Quixote.
To put it simply, there are more or less students in public high schools in the United States who are affiliated with gangs and are non-staff members of gangs who sell drugs to students in the school.
The person in front of me was very suspicious in terms of skin color and behavior.
Just when he was about to refuse, he heard the system prompt:
[Trigger mission: Chivalry]
